title: Conditional κ = 0.00302235 (+5.742e-7 over #4610): one owned helper relation
body:
This construction gives **conditional κ = 60447/20000000 = 0.00302235**, a gain of **0.0000005742** over Cao Yifan's final [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610) value, 0.0030217758. It changes the complete paid profile and moves its raw crossing. The selected frontier is unchanged.

The [proof and complete bill](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c448d13c71908647f968b06cddb795ce7d288139/research/kappa-owned-relation-20261023/README.md), [exact result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c448d13c71908647f968b06cddb795ce7d288139/research/kappa-owned-relation-20261023/RESULT.json), [literal word](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c448d13c71908647f968b06cddb795ce7d288139/research/kappa-owned-relation-20261023/WORD.json.gz) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c448d13c71908647f968b06cddb795ce7d288139/research/kappa-owned-relation-20261023/SOURCES.json) define the review scope.

In each backward call, make L230 private and prepare `h230 = h324 - h326 - h328 + h333` from four arbitrary cold helpers. Debit its rank-nine productive output. Let `Delta = h230 - h324 + h326 + h328 - h333`. Exact replay of the unrestricted source gives `C0 - saved_L92 = Delta/4` at center event 11332, and `L92 = -Delta/4` at climb event 15584. The saved value is taken just after event 11205 in the same frame as the center output. Under the prepared relation, one owned copy replaces the rank-eight job, and physical identity on a proved zero row replaces the rank-one job. All event indices are zero-based.

All 224 main inputs and the other 407 backward helper inputs remain arbitrary and independent. Every retained output keeps its complete source operator. Forward calls keep all 408 helpers. Explicit clears remove arbitrary owned entry values and erase every private output. One new private slot and 46 additional scalar operations per backward call are charged. Every retained Gaussian operator, native map, frame gauge and main adapter is unchanged.

The p16/a7 controller has 16 backward calls, two forward calls and 15 query shears. Its complete difference is **−16 H1 −16 H8 paid jobs and −16 H9 targets**. For every `0<t<1`, the target-minus-paid moment gains `16(1+8^t−9^t)>0`. The new bill has **64,372 paid jobs, 10,912 productive fields and rank surplus 752**, with every main, idle, query and completion term included.

Two rational interval engines check the complete bill. The fixed-profile crossing lies in **(0.00302238736347, 0.00302238736348)**. The claimed κ leaves more than **0.00000003736347** raw headroom. The separately tested saving is 0.00302236. Both completion tails, the finite compiler at `N=2^31385200000000`, and all **54 strict plus four functional outer predicates** pass. The complete raw nonrecursive bound remains **181,098,496 < 10^9**.

Base: canonical main [7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56), priority revision 7. The source is the final [PR #4610 word](https://github.com/intqwq/integer-mult-bounds/blob/20bb93cd990d2ff683e4d0fc56b87a42cd5d3296/research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022/ACTUAL-WORD.json.gz) at `20bb93cd990d2ff683e4d0fc56b87a42cd5d3296`; all consumed bytes are in the recorded main base. The [scoped Discussion claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19153737) distinguishes this changed inventory from the original-input cache and all-helper-return investigations. Live PRs and Discussions were checked again before publication.

Use standard-library Python 3.12 from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/kappa-owned-relation-20261023
```

Both registered normal and optimized replays pass:

```text
PASS_CONDITIONAL_KAPPA_00302235_ONE_OWNED_RELATION
```

Verification covers exact free-word rows in both source and candidate orientations, all independent and owned entry columns, frame/rank checks, two separately computed source identities, the p16 Laurent factorization and scalar boundaries, independent full invoice counts, two rational interval engines, the fixed-profile ceiling, compiler and outer inequalities. Seven native and five cost/outer controls reject wrong relation, ownership, snapshot, gauge, rank, helper credit and compiler assumptions. Metadata, committed-byte checks, official export integrity and Git-free replay also pass. The optional full-history preflight is not claimed in this shallow checkout.

The [source absolute-phase receipt](https://github.com/intqwq/integer-mult-bounds/blob/20bb93cd990d2ff683e4d0fc56b87a42cd5d3296/research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022/PHASE-VALIDATION.json.gz) is authenticated and reused. New operations are same-frame scalar operations, owned copies/clears and identity on zero; there is no new Gaussian phase recipe. Full source phase lowering, BIT native replay, Lean, Docker, physical tape/precision execution, analytic decomposition and integer recovery were not rerun. The bound retains the source permitted-erasure, whole-job, mixed-target all-size, native, precision, tape, analytic, prime and exact-recovery contracts. It is a conditional construction with exact finite evidence, not an unconditional theorem, practical speedup or independent human acceptance. The compiled word is algorithmically specified and not materialized.

Cao Yifan supplied the source construction and prior κ in [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610). Cinna Davis supplied the p16 controller and helper lineage in [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470). The [pricing source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/kappa-interface-round2-20261022/price_profile.py) retains zxv's completion/compiler and Jacob Alan Sussman's mixed-target credit; Dugongue's transported frames and the wider native lineage remain credited. zxv's [PR #5283](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5283) supplied the cache-contract handoff to find actual matching rows and lifetimes; its standalone example is not used here. The new result is this helper relation, its exact native realization and its complete positive bill.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Next review task: check the three source rows and COPY/zero argument, then the inherited transfer assumptions. No broader helper-relation search is claimed.
